narrative.overview: The landing page is a type specimen of the product name set on paper. The word sivlo is the subject of the page, rendered at awe scale in a variable editorial grotesque, measured the way a foundry measures type: hairlines, baseline rules, and mono coordinates. The world is quiet, warm, and precise — premium by restraint. Warm paper is the ground, deep ink is the only voice, and a single cobalt note is reserved for the live action and the boundary of the user's own device. Nothing floats, nothing glows; structure comes from ruled lines, not panels.
keyCharacteristics: Paper as ground; ink as voice; hairlines as the only ornament.
One cobalt note (primary action, 'your device' boundary, live proof) per screen, never more.
All data spoken in IBM Plex Mono coordinates at 11px uppercase.
Awe-scale display type capped at 6rem; tight tracking; never gradient or outlined.
Flat by default; depth is suggested by ruled plates, never shadows.

rules.name: The One Note Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears on ≤15% of any given screen, and only where the product acts or proves itself. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Measured Label Rule
rules.body: Mono is never costume: every mono line names a real measurement or datum. If it is not data, it does not wear mono.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. A heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No shadow, no glow, no blur washes on content; hover moves the button one pixel and deepens the cobalt.

dos: Do build every structure from hairlines — strong rules only where a ledger begins or ends.
Do set every measurement in IBM Plex Mono uppercase at 11px with +.05em tracking.
Do keep the cobalt to one note per screen: the action or the proof.
Do use the variable weight of Schibsted Grotesk for the brand word (live 450-800) and never read below 450 while visible.
Do fade sections with opacity alone, settle, then ship.
Do prefer commas and periods; the copy voice is measured, not hyphenated.
donts: Don't use cards, soft-shadow panels, or rounded containers — the ledger and the plate are the only two shapes.
Don't place an eyebrow, kicker, or section number above a heading.
Don't use gradient text, emoji, glyph icons, or a system display face; the word is set in Schibsted Grotesk only.
Don't let the accent exceed one cobalt decision per screen.
Don't ship stat-tile metrics; a single quiet '0 uploads' certificate carries the proof.
